audit_correction.finding: An implementation pilot counted the 64-iteration limit per confirmation trajectory instead of as one endpoint-wide hard budget.
audit_correction.disposition: The pilot is invalid, is not persisted, and cannot affect the development gate.
audit_correction.corrected_contract: Every candidate, primary replay, perturbation confirmation, restart and fallback shares the existing endpoint-wide WorkLedger maximum_iterations=64 hard cap; crossing it returns typed unknown with budget_exhausted=true.

candidate_algorithm.jacobian_seed: charged central finite differences at the current precision
candidate_algorithm.restart_rule: After every fourth accepted secant update, recompute the charged finite-difference Jacobian at the current point; no family, id, Gold or target identity is read.
candidate_algorithm.restart_rationale: A fixed restart bounds linear-convergence stagnation while preserving the good-Broyden lane and exposing all derivative work to the common callback/deadline budget.
candidate_algorithm.route: C2/C3V square systems with strict canonical residual and the same rank deficiency/nullity at 128 and 256 bits and at finite-difference radius multipliers 1 and 0.5.
candidate_algorithm.confirmation: two independently seeded perturbation trajectories, sharing the endpoint-wide hard budget
candidate_algorithm.promotion: stable route, canonical primary and confirmation replay, linear trace, and typed configuration/target error evidence

control_algorithm.implementation: independent inverse-secant update seeded and restarted from the analytic Jacobian
